environment.memory_measure: physical footprint of a fresh process (macOS footprint)

population: EHRs alternating an opt-out from a date particular to each EHR with a mental-health restriction from such a date, each kept by a gate-keeper particular to the EHR

before.what: the whole-set EhrAccessIndex: every EHR with settings parsed and held, and the per-request condition judging each twice

after.what: settings classes and facts (app/ferroehr/benches/access_classes.rs), and the per-EHR copy capped at copy_capacity entries
